title: EM fitting two bell curves
sub: Alternate: guess who belongs to which curve (E), then refit the curves to those guesses (M).

frames.caption: 50 heights from two hidden groups, but nobody told us who is in which. Start with a rough guess: two wide bell curves at 150 and 190.
Iteration 1, E-step: color each point by how likely it is to belong to each curve, given the current curves. Purple points are genuinely unsure.
Iteration 1, M-step: refit each curve as a weighted average of the points, weighting by those colors. The fit improved: log-likelihood -181.7.
